# Julia 实现：情感分析 {#sec-sentiment-julia}

本章用 Julia 重现第 \@ref(sec-sentiment) 章的内容：使用情感词典对文本进行情感分析。Julia 端用 **DataFrames.jl** 做数据操作，**TextAnalysis.jl** 提供分词和语料管理，**CairoMakie.jl** 绘图。情感词典（AFINN、Bing、NRC）从统一导出的 parquet 读取。

## 情感词典

加载三个情感词典（AFINN、Bing、NRC），查看其结构。

```{julia}
using DataFrames, Parquet2

afinn = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/afinn.parquet"))
nrc = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/nrc.parquet"))
println("AFINN: ", nrow(afinn), " rows")
first(afinn, 5)
```

```{julia}
println("NRC: ", nrow(nrc), " rows")
first(nrc, 5)
```

## 《红楼梦》英译本情感分析

从 parquet 读取《红楼梦》英译本，分词后进行情感分析。

```{julia}
hongloumeng_en = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/hongloumeng_en.parquet"))
println("行数: ", nrow(hongloumeng_en), ", 列: ", names(hongloumeng_en))
first(hongloumeng_en, 5)
```

```{julia}
# 英文停止词
en_stopwords = Set(split("i me my myself we our ours ourselves you your yours yourself yourselves
him himselves his himself she her hers herself it its itself they them their theirs
themselves what which who whom this that these those am is are was were be been being
have has had having do does did doing a an the and but if or because as until while of at
by for with about against between through during before after above below to from up down
in out on off over under again further then once here there when where why how all both each
few more most other some such no nor not only own same so than too very s t can will just don
should now d ll m o re ve y ain aren couldn didn doesn hadn hasn haven isn ma mightn
mustn needn shan shouldn wasn weren won wouldn"))
```

按上下半部分（book）和章节划分，展开为每行一词：

```{julia}
# 标记 book
book_markers = occursin.(Ref(r"HUNG LOU MENG, BOOK [I]+"), coalesce.(hongloumeng_en.text, ""))
hongloumeng_en.book = cumsum(book_markers)

# 标记 linenumber 和 chapter
function add_indices!(df)
    n = nrow(df)
    df.linenumber = 1:n
    chapter_markers = occursin.(Ref(r"^chapter [\divxlc]"), lowercase.(coalesce.(df.text, "")))
    df.chapter = cumsum(chapter_markers)
    return df
end

# 按 book 分组添加索引
hongloumeng_en = combine(groupby(hongloumeng_en, :book), add_indices!)

# 简单英文分词（空格+标点切分，小写化）
function tokenize_en(text)
    ismissing(text) && return String[]
    words = split(replace(text, r"[^a-zA-Z\s]" => ""), r"\s+")
    return [lowercase(w) for w in words if length(w) > 0]
end

# 展开为每行一词
rows = []
for row in eachrow(hongloumeng_en)
    words = tokenize_en(row.text)
    for w in words
        push!(rows, (book = row.book, linenumber = row.linenumber, chapter = row.chapter, word = w))
    end
end
tidy_books = DataFrame(rows)
println("总词数: ", nrow(tidy_books))
first(tidy_books, 5)
```

### NRC 词典：最常见的"开心"词

```{julia}
nrc_joy = filter(:sentiment => ==("joy"), nrc)
book1_joy = innerjoin(filter(:book => ==(1), tidy_books), nrc_joy, on = :word)
sort(combine(groupby(book1_joy, :word), nrow => :n), :n, rev = true)
```

### Bing 词典：叙事过程中的情感变化

```{julia}
bing_dict = filter(:sentiment => s -> s in ["positive", "negative"], nrc)

net_sent = innerjoin(tidy_books, bing_dict, on = :word)
net_sent.index = net_sent.linenumber .÷ 100

# 按 book, index, sentiment 计数
counts = combine(groupby(net_sent, [:book, :index, :sentiment]), nrow => :n)
# pivot
pos = filter(:sentiment => ==("positive"), counts)
neg = filter(:sentiment => ==("negative"), counts)
merged = outerjoin(pos[:, [:book, :index, :n]], neg[:, [:book, :index, :n]], on = [:book, :index])
rename!(merged, :n => :positive, :n_1 => :negative)
coalesce!.(merged.positive, 0)
coalesce!.(merged.negative, 0)
merged.sentiment = merged.positive .- merged.negative
sort!(merged, [:book, :index])
first(merged, 10)
```

绘制情感变化图（等价于图 \@ref(fig-sentimentplot)）：

```{julia}
#| label: fig-sentimentplot-jl
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》英译本叙事过程中的情感（Julia）"
using CairoMakie
CairoMakie.activate!()
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 400))
for (i, book) in enumerate([1, 2])
    sub = filter(:book => ==(book), merged)
    ax = Axis(fig[1, i]; title = "Book $book", xlabel = "Index (每100行)", ylabel = "Net sentiment")
    colors = [s < 0 ? :red : :green for s in sub.sentiment]
    barplot!(ax, 1:nrow(sub), sub.sentiment; color = colors)
end
fig
```

## 三个情感词典的比较

用 AFINN、Bing、NRC 三种词典分别计算下半部（book 2）的情感变化。

```{julia}
book2 = filter(:book => ==(2), tidy_books)
book2.index = book2.linenumber .÷ 100

# AFINN
afinn_book2 = innerjoin(book2, afinn, on = :word)
afinn_by_index = combine(groupby(afinn_book2, :index), :value => sum => :sentiment)
afinn_by_index.method .= "AFINN"

# Bing
bing_book2 = innerjoin(book2, bing_dict, on = :word)
bing_counts = combine(groupby(bing_book2, [:index, :sentiment]), nrow => :n)
bing_pos = filter(:sentiment => ==("positive"), bing_counts)[:, [:index, :n]]
bing_neg = filter(:sentiment => ==("negative"), bing_counts)[:, [:index, :n]]
bing_merged = outerjoin(bing_pos, bing_neg, on = :index)
rename!(bing_merged, :n => :positive, :n_1 => :negative)
coalesce!.(bing_merged.positive, 0)
coalesce!.(bing_merged.negative, 0)
bing_merged.sentiment = bing_merged.positive .- bing_merged.negative
bing_merged.method .= "Bing et al."
bing_merged = bing_merged[:, [:index, :sentiment, :method]]

# NRC
nrc_posneg = filter(:sentiment => s -> s in ["positive", "negative"], nrc)
nrc_book2 = innerjoin(book2, nrc_posneg, on = :word)
nrc_counts = combine(groupby(nrc_book2, [:index, :sentiment]), nrow => :n)
nrc_pos = filter(:sentiment => ==("positive"), nrc_counts)[:, [:index, :n]]
nrc_neg = filter(:sentiment => ==("negative"), nrc_counts)[:, [:index, :n]]
nrc_merged = outerjoin(nrc_pos, nrc_neg, on = :index)
rename!(nrc_merged, :n => :positive, :n_1 => :negative)
coalesce!.(nrc_merged.positive, 0)
coalesce!.(nrc_merged.negative, 0)
nrc_merged.sentiment = nrc_merged.positive .- nrc_merged.negative
nrc_merged.method .= "NRC"
nrc_merged = nrc_merged[:, [:index, :sentiment, :method]]

compare = vcat(afinn_by_index[:, [:index, :sentiment, :method]], bing_merged, nrc_merged)
first(compare, 10)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-compareplot-jl
#| fig-cap: "用《红楼梦》英译本下半部比较三个情感词典（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 700))
methods_list = ["AFINN", "Bing et al.", "NRC"]
for (i, m) in enumerate(methods_list)
    sub = filter(:method => ==(m), compare)
    ax = Axis(fig[i, 1]; title = m, xlabel = "Index (每100行)", ylabel = "Sentiment")
    colors = [s < 0 ? :red : :green for s in sub.sentiment]
    barplot!(ax, 1:nrow(sub), sub.sentiment; color = colors)
end
fig
```

## 最常见的正面词和负面词

```{julia}
bing_word_counts = combine(groupby(innerjoin(tidy_books, bing_dict, on = :word), [:word, :sentiment]),
                           nrow => :n)
sort!(bing_word_counts, :n, rev = true)
first(bing_word_counts, 10)
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-pipetoplot-jl
#| fig-cap: "《红楼梦》英译本中正面和负面情感的词（Julia）"
set_theme!(fonts = (regular = "Noto Sans CJK SC", bold = "Noto Sans CJK SC"))

fig = Figure(size = (800, 400))
for (i, sent) in enumerate(["negative", "positive"])
    sub = filter(:sentiment => ==(sent), bing_word_counts)
    top10 = first(sub, 10)
    sort!(top10, :n)
    color = sent == "positive" ? :green : :red
    ax = Axis(fig[1, i]; title = sent, xlabel = "Count",
              yticks = (collect(1:nrow(top10)), top10.word))
    barplot!(ax, collect(1:nrow(top10)), top10.n; color = color)
end
fig
```

## 中文《红楼梦》词云

```{julia}
include("data/jieba_fmm.jl")
using Parquet2

hongloumeng = DataFrame(Parquet2.Dataset("data/common/hongloumeng.parquet"))
dict = load_dict("data/jieba_dict.txt")
stopwords_zh = load_stopwords("data/stop_word_zh.utf8")

# 分词并统计词频
word_freq = Dict{String, Int}()
for row in eachrow(hongloumeng)
    ismissing(row.text) && continue
    words = fmm_segment(row.text, dict)
    for w in words
        w = strip(w)
        isempty(w) && continue
        w in stopwords_zh && continue
        word_freq[w] = get(word_freq, w, 0) + 1
    end
end

# Top 20
sorted_words = sort(collect(word_freq), by = x -> x[2], rev = true)
for (w, c) in sorted_words[1:20]
    println("$w: $c")
end
```

> 注：Julia 生态中没有成熟的词云包，此处仅展示词频统计。可视化可用 CairoMakie 的 `barplot!` 替代。

## R vs Julia 对比

| 任务 | R | Julia |
|---|---|---|
| 情感词典 | tidytext `get_sentiments()` | `Parquet2.Dataset()` 直接读取 |
| 情感分析 | `inner_join(sentiments)` | `innerjoin(df, dict, on=:word)` |
| 情感统计 | `count(sentiment)` + `spread()` | `combine(groupby, nrow)` + pivot |
| 词云 | wordcloud2 | 仅词频统计（Julia 无成熟词云包） |
| 句子分词 | `unnest_tokens(token="sentences")` | 手动 `split()` |
| 绘图 | ggplot2 | CairoMakie |

Julia 的文本处理生态不如 R/Python 成熟，英文分词需要手动实现或依赖 TextAnalysis.jl。情感词典内容与 R 完全一致（同一 parquet 数据源），分析结果应一致。
